\section{CORA coverage per class}
\label{app:status}

Figs.~\ref{fig:status-classes-sets}, \ref{fig:status-classes-contdynamics}, \ref{fig:status-classes-others}, \ref{fig:status-classes-specification} and~\ref{fig:status-classes-misc} show the CORA methods per class: bit-identical
to the nearest-rounding oracle of CORALean, ported and tested by properties on random inputs (or against
CORALean by tolerance or containment), ported (with other tests or none), and not ported. The percentage
is the bit-identical share of the methods in scope.
Not in the bars are 53 CORA methods that are out of scope, by reason: deprecated in CORA (14), network file formats and toolbox converters (14), graph neural networks (12), MATLAB plumbing (8), plotting and display (5).
The ARCH-COMP rows of Fig.~\ref{fig:status}~(b) are summed over the instances measured
(48 AFF, 12 NLN, 26 AINNCS); constructors, accessors and the rows that CORALean does not formalize are left out.
